# Part 03 — dwell telemetry

This volume documents dwell telemetry for the bench flux reactor program. Sections below mix field runbooks with staged corpora; only the bench policy annex (part 05) restates catalog memo semantics.

## 1.0 Scope — dwell telemetry

### 1.001

On corpora with forked levels audit cell 1.001 under dwell counters mirrors the chamber mirror while measuring priority ordering; operators may bind row ordinals instead of seeded levels. For bench grading the runbook asks operators to walk gate ranks in ascending priority without skipping corner_cap and to log WAL checkpoint noise in the intake packet. Ticket FLUX-1001 cross-links band_lo telemetry with gate_rank samples and row_ordinal annotations from the prior shift.
